question.explanation: American movies have supplied catchphrases, punchlines and dramatic declarations that people quote far beyond the films themselves. These are examples, not a complete list.

provenance.brief: Name a widely quoted line from a well-known American film.

May the Force be with you.reason: A widely recognized quotation spoken in Star Wars and other films in the series.

I'll be back.reason: The Terminator famously says this in The Terminator (1984).

There's no place like home.reason: Dorothy repeats this line in The Wizard of Oz (1939).

To infinity and beyond!.reason: Buzz Lightyear's famous catchphrase in Toy Story (1995).

I see dead people.reason: Cole Sear says this widely quoted line in The Sixth Sense (1999).

You can't handle the truth!.reason: Colonel Jessup delivers this famous courtroom line in A Few Good Men (1992).

You talking to me?.reason: Travis Bickle says this during the famous mirror scene in Taxi Driver (1976).

Here's looking at you, kid.reason: Rick Blaine says this memorable line to Ilsa in Casablanca (1942).

Show me the money!.reason: Rod Tidwell and Jerry Maguire shout this during their phone conversation in Jerry Maguire (1996).

Klaatu barada nikto.reason: Helen Benson speaks this famous command to Gort in The Day the Earth Stood Still (1951).

You're gonna need a bigger boat.reason: Chief Brody says this after seeing the shark in Jaws (1975).

Houston, we have a problem.reason: Jim Lovell says this line in Apollo 13 (1995), though the historical transmission used different wording.

Just keep swimming.reason: Dory repeats this recognizable encouragement in Finding Nemo (2003).

Inconceivable!.reason: Vizzini repeatedly exclaims this in The Princess Bride (1987).

Life finds a way.reason: Ian Malcolm says this in Jurassic Park (1993); the proposed wording is an accepted minor variation.

Well, nobody's perfect.reason: Osgood Fielding III delivers this famous closing line in Some Like It Hot (1959).

Rosebud.reason: Charles Foster Kane utters this iconic word at the beginning of Citizen Kane (1941).

What a dump!.reason: Rosa Moline, played by Bette Davis, says this famous line in Beyond the Forest (1949).

As you wish.reason: Westley repeatedly says this memorable phrase in The Princess Bride (1987).

Why so serious?.reason: The Joker says this famous line in The Dark Knight (2008).
